meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 BGPT MCP 服务器搜索科学论文,并返回从论文全文提取的结构化实验数据,每篇包含方法、结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25 个以上字段。
howto.when: 当你提到要找具体实验细节的论文、做文献综述,或想对比各研究的样本量/方法/质量评分等时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜关于“CRISPR 在人类细胞中的编辑效率”的论文。
say.note: 会返回方法、结果、样本量等结构化字段。

say.text: 找几篇研究不同治疗方法的论文,列出样本量和方法。
say.note: 可跨研究对比实验设计。

say.text: 检索有质量评分的随机对照试验,整理成证据表。
say.note: 输出表格化的研究数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches scientific papers via the BGPT MCP server and returns structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies, with 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for papers with specific experimental details, do a literature review, or want to compare sample sizes, methods, or quality scores across studies.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells.
say_en.note: Returns fields such as methods, results, and sample sizes.

say_en.text: Find papers comparing different treatment methods and list sample sizes and methods.
say_en.note: Allows comparison of experimental designs across studies.

say_en.text: Search for randomized controlled trials with quality scores and build an evidence table.
say_en.note: Outputs structured study data in a table.
